name: Disneyland Café Daisy (Toontown) Cheesy Pizza Flop-Over (Folded Mozzarella & Provolone Flatbread)
whyItWorks: A soft folded flatbread calzone-style pocket with provolone, mozzarella, and light tomato sauce (also available as a smaller Kids' Mini Cheese Flop-Over).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Cheesy Pizza Flop-Over (not Pepperoni) and take a lactase enzyme tablet before eating.
watchOuts: Contains mozzarella dairy and tomato sauce; skip Café Daisy's Spring Garden Wrap (quinoa, pumpkin seeds, and lemon vinaigrette)
